title: Sita aur Draupadi ka Chhath

hook: Sita aur Draupadi ne kaun sa vrat rakha?
source: Lok parampara (Munger, Bihar): Sita Charan; lok manyata (Draupadi); Mahabharata (KM Ganguli) Vana Parva sec. 3 (Yudhishthira ki Surya aradhana, tamra patra)

scenes.prompt: Dramatic cinematic close-up portrait of Mata Sita as a serene radiant divine queen with a gentle face, simple yellow silk saree, delicate gold jewellery and a soft golden halo, the rising sun glowing behind her over the Ganga, the face in the lower half of the frame
scenes.tts: माता सीता और द्रौपदी ने कौन सा व्रत रखा था?
scenes.sub: Mata Sita aur Draupadi ne kaun sa vrat rakha tha?

scenes.prompt: Women devotees in bright saris standing in a misty river at sunrise seen from behind, raising bamboo soop baskets with lit diyas towards the rising sun, cinematic wide shot
scenes.tts: छठ बिहार का महापर्व है। पर लोक मान्यता इसे रामायण और महाभारत के समय से जोड़ती है।
scenes.sub: Chhath Bihar ka mahaparv hai. Par lok manyata ise Ramayan aur Mahabharat ke samay se jodti hai.

scenes.prompt: Mata Sita in a simple yellow saree standing in the shallow Ganga at sunrise near a rocky river bank, offering water to the rising sun from a small copper vessel, a rishi's hermitage on the bank, serene, cinematic
scenes.label: tradition
scenes.tts: लोककथा के अनुसार, माता सीता ने मुंगेर में सूर्य षष्ठी का व्रत किया। मुद्गल ऋषि के आश्रम में।
scenes.sub: Lok katha ke anusar, Mata Sita ne Munger mein Surya Shashthi ka vrat kiya. Mudgal rishi ke ashram mein.

scenes.prompt: A small white temple on a large rock in the middle of the wide Ganga river at sunrise, golden light on the water, boats in the distance, peaceful, cinematic wide shot
scenes.tts: मुंगेर में गंगा की चट्टान पर आज भी सीता चरण है, जहाँ चरणों के निशान माने जाते हैं।
scenes.sub: Munger mein Ganga ki chattaan par aaj bhi Sita Charan hai, jahaan charanon ke nishaan maane jaate hain.

scenes.prompt: Draupadi as a dignified queen in deep red silk saree standing in a river at dawn with folded hands, eyes closed in prayer towards the rising sun, a lit diya floating beside her, cinematic
scenes.label: tradition
scenes.tts: और द्रौपदी! मान्यता है, जब पांडव राजपाट हार गए, तब द्रौपदी ने छठ का व्रत रखा।
scenes.sub: Aur Draupadi! Manyata hai, jab Pandav raajpaat haar gaye, tab Draupadi ne Chhath ka vrat rakha.

scenes.prompt: The radiant sun god Surya with a golden crown appearing in a blaze of golden light, giving a shining copper vessel to a humble king in simple forest clothes with folded hands, a forest hermitage at dawn, cinematic
scenes.tts: और महाभारत में, धौम्य ऋषि की सलाह पर युधिष्ठिर ने सूर्य देव की आराधना की। सूर्य ने उन्हें अक्षय पात्र दिया!
scenes.sub: Aur Mahabharat mein, Dhaumya rishi ki salaah par Yudhishthir ne Surya Dev ki aaradhana ki. Surya ne unhein Akshaya Patra diya!

scenes.prompt: A single lit clay diya on a bamboo soop basket on the river bank at sunrise, golden mist over the water, hopeful and peaceful, cinematic close shot
scenes.tts: सीख यही है, संकट कितना भी बड़ा हो, आस्था का दीया जलाए रखो।
scenes.sub: Seekh yahi hai, sankat kitna bhi bada ho, aastha ka diya jalaaye rakho.

scenes.tts: छठी मैया सबकी मनोकामना पूरी करें! कमेंट में लिखें जय छठी मैया, और लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें।

facts.claim: Folk belief: Mata Sita kept the Surya Shashthi vrat at Munger (Mudgal rishi's ashram); Sita Charan footprints
Sita Charan: a rock in the Ganga at Munger with footprints believed to be Sita's
facts.source: Munger district administration (tourist place: Manpatthar / Sita Charan)

facts.claim: Folk belief: Draupadi kept the Chhath vrat when the Pandavas had lost their kingdom (not a Mahabharata episode)
On Dhaumya's advice Yudhishthira worshipped Surya and received a copper vessel whose food would not run out (popularly the Akshaya Patra)
